title: BEFORE the flood

items.question: Which item should be packed FIRST in a go-bag?
When should your family leave for the evacuation center?
choices: When the water reaches the door

items.question: Which is the safest light to use during a power outage?
Where should important documents be kept in a go-bag?
Which route is safest when evacuating from a flood?
choices: Up the road to higher ground

items.question: A battery radio helps you hear official advisories when the power is out.
You should wait until the water is inside your house before you evacuate.
A go-bag should include the medicines your family needs every day.
Party balloons are an essential go-bag item.
Your family should know the evacuation route before a storm comes.
